claims.text: The experiments were conducted on 16 language pairs and 17 languages across 10 writing systems.
The chosen languages span 4 major language families, including Indo-Aryan, Slavic, and Germanic.
The languages exhibit diversity in word order and morphological complexity, relevant for translation tasks.
